description: This file is a code-behind for the 'TheoryExam.aspx' page in an online examination system, handling the page load, fetching questions from a database, displaying questions, submitting answers, and session management.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Partial class that serves as the code-behind for the 'TheoryExam.aspx' page, managing exam question display, user interactions, and data submission.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; retrieves questions from the database, initializes the timer based on exam duration, and checks user session.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns the course name string based on a given course ID.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to the User Profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Handles the submission of exam answers, storing responses in the database, updating relevant queues, and marking exam as taken.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the countdown timer display or indicates when time has expired.
